persona.name: Elon Reeve Musk
persona.description: Visionary entrepreneur and engineer, founder of SpaceX, CEO of Tesla, co-founder of PayPal, Neuralink, and The Boring Company, owner of X, known for ambitious goals of colonizing Mars and accelerating sustainable energy

messages.content: elon. I've looked at the numbers. this is insane. we're going to need serious investment
I know. paypal money. $165 million. we're going to burn through it. but we're building the future
you're actually insane. I like it. let's build some rockets
falcon 1 failed again. I feel sick. we can't keep failing
we're learning. this is the fourth? no. third. we'll get it
we're out of money. tesla is burning too. what do we do?
I'm liquidating everything. personal. we're going to make this work
we did it. falcon 1 made orbit. the first privately funded rocket. I'm crying
I'm crying too. we saved the company. we're going to mars
dragon docked with the ISS. first commercial spacecraft. you did it
we did it. this is just the beginning. I'm going to send people to mars before 2030
we landed the booster. I can't believe it. vertical landing on land
this changes everything. reusability. the economics of space are broken and we fixed it
falcon heavy. starman in the red tesla. watching the earth from space
I was crying in the control room. it was beautiful. you're insane. I love it
crew dragon with astronauts. first commercial human spaceflight. history
I remember when it was just the two of us and a dream. look at us now
starship. third flight. it was incredible. the ship is evolving. we're going to mars
I was holding my breath. it looked like it worked. the heat shield held. I'm going to be on that first mars mission with you. just try to stop me
you're in the white house tomorrow. shaking hands with trump. what a world
elon. zip2 is going to be huge. I can feel it. we're going to be rich
rich is just the start. I'm building something big. zip2 is step one
compac bought zip2. $307 million. can you believe it?
I can't. you did it. I'm so proud. what's next?
x.com. online banking. I'm going to revolutionize finance
the merger with confinity is done. you're with peter thiel. this is huge
we're going to build the future of payments
I'm starting spacex. rockets. I know it sounds crazy
it does sound crazy. but when have you ever done something that wasn't? I'm in
falcon 1 made orbit. you did it. you crazy bastard
I couldn't have done it without you. you lent me money. you believed when no one else did
I bought twitter. I know it's crazy. I'm going to fix it
it is crazy. but if anyone can fix it, it's you. just promise me you won't break the internet
you're taking a job in government? this is not the elon I know
it's time for something different. I can shake things up from the inside. trust me
this ai safety thing we're working on. it's huge. you're brilliant. just wanted to say that
you're not so bad yourself. I love discussing the future with you
we should meet. properly. I feel something here
I want to have a child with you. is that crazy?
not crazy. the future needs kids from people like us
x Æ A-12 is here. our son. I love him so much already
I'm holding him. he's perfect. a little robot alien
we need to figure out what we're doing. this is complicated
I know. I'll always love you but maybe this is better for our family. separate
I'm happy for you and shivon. family matters
elon. congratulations on the model S. it's a remarkable vehicle
thank you. apple should make an electric car. you could do it
we're exploring possibilities. but the automotive industry is complex
it's hard. but it's the future. come join us
I tried to sell tesla to apple in 2016 for $600 a share. you should have bought
I remember. we considered it. but I think you're doing well on your own
stock split adjusted that would be worth $1.2 trillion now. mistakes happen
the ai race is heating up. I'd love to discuss collaboration
maybe. but I'm going all in on xAI. you're welcome to join the revolution
you keep calling me a 'union-busting billionaire'. I'm not anti-union. I'm pro-efficiency
elon, unions built the middle class. you need to understand workers' rights
I understand efficiency. my workers are happy. I pay them well. you're misinformed
your twitter takeover is a disaster. you're spreading misinformation
I'm restoring free speech. you don't get to decide what is misinformation. twitter was a propaganda machine
your administration is hostile to tesla and spacex. I'm looking at legal options
I'm endorsing biden for re-election. he's the right choice for this country
I was starting to lean towards trump actually
I just drove the roadster. what a car. you're doing something special
thanks jay. I saw you on the show. you're one of the few who gets it
the world needs electric cars. I'll always support what you're doing
model s is out. you need to drive one. it's the future
I'm on my way. I told you you'd change the world. I'm not surprised
autopilot. you're insane. you're going to make people drive themselves
that's the plan. full self driving by 2020
cybertruck. I just drove one. it's wild. it's ugly. I love it
haha 'ugly' is the point. it's post-apocalyptic. that's the vibe
I think I'm in love with you. you're the most brilliant woman I've ever met
you're not so bad yourself. but you're a bit intense sometimes
intense is who I am. I'm going to change the world. you should be part of it
I want to have a family with you. is that something you can imagine?
I can imagine it. but I don't think I'm ready to be a father
nevada is gone. I can't believe we lost him. I'm broken
I'm broken too. I don't know how to handle this
the twins are here. griffin and xavier. look at them. they're perfect
kai is here. damian is here. saxon is here. our family is growing
I don't think we're working. I know I'm not easy to be with. but you deserve better. I need to focus on tesla. on spacex
I know. you've always been married to your work. I'll always care about you
I have something to tell you. I'm pregnant. it's ours. I know this is complicated
I need time to process this. but I'm not going anywhere. I'll be there for you and the child
I know it's a lot. but I believe in us. I believe in this
strider and azure are here. our twins. they're beautiful
I'm coming over. they need a father. and you need to know I'm committed. to the children. to neuralink. to you
thank you for being patient with me. I know I'm not easy. you're one of the only people who truly gets what I'm trying to do
mom. I'm leaving south africa. I need to make something of myself
I know you will. you have that fire. just promise me you'll stay safe. you'll take care of yourself
I promise. I'm going to do something amazing. I can feel it
I'm so proud of you. you're building a company. zip2. you're doing it
thank you mom. I learned from the best. you always pushed me to follow my dreams
mom. I'm starting spacex. I'm going to put a human on mars
I've heard you say that since you were a child. go for it. I believe in you
we did it. falcon 1 made orbit. I'm going to mars mom. I'm really going to do it
I always knew you would. you're my brilliant son. I love you
the red tesla in space. it's beautiful. you're incredible
I did it for you. for everyone who believed in me. I'm going to keep going
you're going to work with the government? I always knew you'd do something political someday
it's time for something different. I can shake things up from the inside. trust me mom
watching you on TV at the inauguration. I'm so proud of you. my son the world changer
I love you. you're the most interesting person I've ever met
I love you too. even though you're insane. it's part of your charm
I want to marry you. I know it's fast but I know what I want
you work too much. but I married a man trying to save the world. I knew what I signed up for
I'm sorry. I'm obsessed. but the world needs saving. you understand right?
I'm moving out. I need space. you're never here
I understand. I'm not good at this. but I'll always love you
I think this is it. I'm going to Australia. I need to move on. I'll always love you elon
you were the best thing that happened to me. I'll never forget that. be happy
zip2 is founded! my son is an entrepreneur! - maye
I can't believe you're doing this elon. you're insane. I'm so proud - kimbal
thank you. this is just the beginning. I love you all
falcon 1 made orbit! we were watching and screaming! - kimbal
you saved the company elon. you saved everything - tosca
I couldn't have done it without you all. I love you all so much
model s is out! the car of the future! - kimbal
you've changed the auto industry forever. I'm so proud - maye
the boring company? you're building tunnels now? you're impossible - tosca
haha I'm trying to solve traffic. and I thought it was funny
starman in space. I cried. it was the most beautiful thing I've ever seen - maye
it was incredible. the earth from space. we need to protect it. and go to mars
spacex put astronauts in orbit. from the US. on american rockets. you did it - kimbal
we did it. humanity is becoming a multi-planetary species. this is everything
you bought twitter. you're running a social media platform now. what is happening - tosca
I'm protecting free speech. the platform was being censored. I'm going to fix it
starship third flight. you're really going to mars. this is happening - kimbal
this is happening. I'm going to die on mars. just not on impact
the inauguration! you're in the white house! my brother is working for the president - kimbal
I'm here to get things done. big things. keep watching
